title: Company Segment Activity Schedule for Card-Paid Points, Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements
content:
**Schedule.** For a flown card-paid segment of a Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements agreement, the company's segment activity adds to the card-paid uplift. The company's segment activity is the number of flown coupons on the company's tickets, placed by flight date, in the segment-activity window of 12 calendar months up to and including the posting date. The flown coupons are those in the fare ledger of the company's tickets under Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.

| Flown coupons in the 12-month window | Addition to the card-paid uplift |
|---|---|
| 30 or more | 12 percentage points |
| 15 or more, and fewer than 30 | 6 percentage points |
| fewer than 15 | nothing |

**How the card-paid uplift acts.** The card-paid uplift is counted in percentage points; uplifts on different grounds are added together, and the segment's earned card-paid segment points are raised by the total: the points posted are the earned points multiplied by one hundred plus the card-paid uplift, divided by one hundred, rounded down to the whole point once at the end.

### Boundary rows

| Flown coupons | Addition |
|---|---|
| 14 | nothing |
| 15 | 6 percentage points |
| 29 | 6 percentage points |
| 30 | 12 percentage points |

### Example (hypothetical)

A company with 31 flown coupons in the window posts a card-paid segment whose earned points are 709 and which carries no other uplift: 709 multiplied by 112 and divided by one hundred is 794.08, so 794 points are posted.
